name: Sequentum · Every job posting, added or pulled.
alt: Animated infographic: Sequentum, Massive and your code in a stack card, then a ledger of roles from careers pages crawled through a Massive residential proxy pool. The ledger rewinds to yesterday, then today's run replays each change: a Data Engineer row slides in as Added, a location flips from Remote to Lisbon as Updated, a Support Lead row is struck through as Deleted, and an ML Researcher row returns as Reappeared. The setup card shows the proxy pool and change tracking. Headline: Every job posting, added or pulled.
